supporting_pages.title: "Perform similarity vector search in Bigtable by finding the K-nearest neighbors\
evidence_snippets: The BigtableVectorStore class provides readymade methods for running vector K-nearest neighbors searches, enriched with metadata filtering features.
We recommend that you try the Bigtable vector store for LangChain instead.
